name: Hawksbill Loop
terrain: Rocky switchbacks through hardwood forest with a short scramble near the summit.
accessibility: Not wheelchair accessible; rocky footing and stone steps near the top.
water_notes: No reliable water on route. Carry what you need.
conditions: Open in dry weather. Expect ice on the upper rocks after rain in cold months.
highlights: Stone observation platform at the summit

name: Dark Hollow Falls
terrain: Well-graded path with steady downhill to a waterfall and a climb back out.
accessibility: Short section near the falls has steps; the rest is a graded dirt path.
water_notes: Stream at the falls. Treat before drinking.
conditions: Can be busy on weekends. Rocks near the falls are slippery when wet.

name: Bear Mountain Meadow Ramble
terrain: Gentle forest track opening into a high meadow with soft footing.
accessibility: Forest track is passable for most; meadow edges can be soft after rain.
water_notes: No dependable water. Bring at least a litre.
conditions: Quiet route. Watch for poison ivy off-trail and ticks in summer.

name: Cedar Run Out-and-Back
terrain: Old road grade alongside a creek, mostly flat with a few wet stretches.
accessibility: First 2 km is a wide, mostly flat gravel grade; the rest narrows and roots cross the path.
water_notes: Cedar Run crosses the trail in several places. Filter before drinking.
conditions: Best after a dry spell. Stream crossings are tricky in high water.

name: Ridge Summit Push
terrain: Sustained climb on exposed ridge with rocky footing and long descents.
accessibility: Not accessible. Steep, exposed, and strenuous throughout.
water_notes: Carry all your water; there is none on the ridge.
conditions: Avoid in thunderstorms; the ridge is exposed. Heat and ice both raise the risk.

name: Wetland Boardwalk
terrain: Flat, smooth boardwalk over wetland with interpretive signs.
accessibility: Wheelchair accessible; level boardwalk with passing spaces.
conditions: Open year round. Mosquitoes are common in warm months.
highlights: Ideal for a short mindful walk
